tools.name: check_readiness
tools.description: Given a domain, return each connectable resource it publishes with a readiness assessment (ready | credentials-required | incomplete | broken, with the exact missing field) read from the service's own metadata. Client-agnostic; read-only. Use connect_domain when you know the client's capabilities.
